Clothing stays blue, cyan, black and white. Preserve the official sculpted connected DADA logo with its two swoosh arcs on the chest, using Image 3. No stars or star patches on any clothing or shoes.
Output: ONE isolated full-body character, 1024x1536 portrait PNG with GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. Keep all hair, fingers and both shoes fully inside the frame with a small margin. No scene, floor, cast shadow, backdrop, gradient, checkerboard pixels, floating graphics or glow outside the silhouette. Do not copy the poster's orange palette, text, stars or background.
